name: retry_utils_ladder
notes: Retry decision ladders — C src/agent/retry_utils.c vs LIVE agent/retry_utils.py: Retry-After parsing (numeric/HTTP-date/invalid), Z.AI coding-plan overload 429 decision chain, and the retry ceiling arithmetic.
